title: Archive R2 copy: ready, waiting on one click

owner_note.text: Enable R2 in the Cloudflare dashboard (R2 → Enable). Then run `npx wrangler r2 bucket create lew42-archive` and `node Server/ArchiveCopy.mjs --plan`, then `--apply`: about 4,982 pictures, 579 MB, $0.00 a month inside the free tier, capped at 10,000 writes a run.
